Common.footer: Caring for the places where we learn.
Common.metadataDescription: Receive and track infrastructure issues across the VAST, USTH campus.

Home.title: Every issue acknowledged. Every space cared for.
Home.description: One place to receive reports, follow progress, and help our campus work better every day.
Home.managerDescription: Review incoming issues, their locations and current status to prepare the next steps.
Home.accessNote: Queue data is only available to accounts with management permission.
Home.principleBody: Original descriptions are preserved. The responsible people make the decisions.
Home.reportDescription: Share the location and describe an issue so the team can review it and take action.

Queue.title: Issue queue
Queue.description: Review each issue to prepare its next step.
Queue.emptyTitle: No issues with this status yet
Queue.emptyDescription: Matching issues will appear here when submitted or updated.
Queue.noMatchesDescription: Try another keyword or clear your search to see the loaded issues.
Queue.authDescription: Sign in with a manager account, then try loading the queue again.
Queue.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this queue
Queue.forbiddenDescription: This area is for managers. Contact your team manager if you need access.
Queue.errorDescription: Please check your connection and try again later. No data has been loaded successfully.
Queue.partial: This is a partial list. Search only covers the issues already loaded.
Queue.detailNote: Summary information from the queue. Reporter-provided content stays in its original language.
Queue.timezone: Times are shown in Vietnam time (UTC+7).
Queue.privacy: The queue does not display photos or reporter identities.

Report.title: Report an issue
Report.intro: Tell us what needs fixing. A clear description helps the team respond faster.
Report.whatHelp: Describe the problem and the equipment affected.
Report.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: Light H2-03 in the middle corridor on floor 2 has been out since this morning…
Report.descriptionHelp: Your description stays in the language you write.
Report.whereHelp: Choose a precise location so the team can find the problem.
Report.indoorPlaceholder: For example: light H2-03, next to room 201
Report.outdoorPlaceholder: For example: beside gate 18-2, under the tree on the left
Report.coordinateHelp: If known, enter both latitude and longitude. A location description alone is enough to submit.
Report.noBuildings: No indoor locations are available yet. You can still report an outdoor issue; ask a manager to add indoor locations.
Report.descriptionRequired: Enter a description containing more than whitespace.
Report.coordinatePair: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
Report.submitHelp: Submitting creates a new issue for a manager to review. Checking suggestions first is optional.
Report.suggestionsHelp: Check open issues near your selected location.
Report.checkingHelp: You can still submit your report while waiting.
Report.suggestionsIdle: Enter a description and location, then check suggestions.
Report.unavailable: Suggestions are temporarily unavailable. You can still submit a new report.
Report.noSuggestions: No relevant suggestions found. You can submit a new report.
Report.suggestionNote: These are suggestions, not confirmed duplicates. A new report will not be automatically merged into these issues.
Report.privacyBody: Suggestions show issue summaries and locations without photos or other reporters’ identities.
Report.authError: Sign in to continue, or your session may have expired. Your current input is kept on this page.
Report.forbiddenError: Your account cannot perform this action. Check email verification and account permissions.
Report.loginTab: Open sign-in in a new tab
Report.loadError: Unable to load data. Check your connection and try again.
Report.locationError: This location is no longer valid. Check the building, floor and area.
Report.categoryError: This category is not valid. Choose another or leave it as “Not sure”.
Report.validationError: Check the description and location before submitting again.
Report.uncertainError: Submission could not be confirmed. Your report may already have been saved. Ask a manager to check before submitting again to avoid duplicates.
Report.successBody: Your report has been saved. A manager will review it and arrange the next steps.
